C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V7.Summary: Expose current and archived plans as a persistent desktop segmented control while restoring the existing lifecycle select below 721 pixels.
C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V7.Problem: The primary active/archive register is hidden in a generic dropdown on desktop. The superseded V6 planning branch also mixed design artifacts into the baseline stage and therefore could not execute the required GRACE baseline lifecycle.

Goals.Goal: Show `Текущие | Архив` permanently at desktop widths from 721 pixels.
Reuse the existing select, server-side `status=active|archived` query and lifecycle controller as the only state authority.
Preserve search and ordinary filters while preventing stale plan detail after a register switch.
Remove the desktop adapter and restore the pre-existing select exactly below 721 pixels without a mobile-specific state machine.
Provide deterministic keyboard, focus and empty states without decorative motion.

Constraints.Constraint: This change supersedes the unmerged planning branch `C-PLANS-LIFECYCLE-DESKTOP-252-V6`; V6 is not a source of release truth.
No API, SQLite schema, migration, plan lifecycle, archive/restore command, source-row decision, evidence or document-intake change.
No mobile list/detail mode, bottom sheet, gesture, mobile navigation or mobile-only transition is introduced; below 721 pixels the existing select remains the only lifecycle control.
Lifecycle view is `never-learn`: statistics cannot select, reorder, relocate or resize the modes.
No CDN, cloud, Docker, mandatory Internet or mandatory LLM dependency is added.

NonGoals.NonGoal: Redesign plan detail or source rows.
Implement reversible exclusion of extracted rows.
Create a separate narrow-screen navigation flow.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: `Текущие | Архив` is permanently visible at widths from 721 pixels and changes the register with one click, Enter, Space, Home, End or a horizontal arrow key.

The legacy lifecycle select is hidden only while the desktop segment is active, remains the sole compatibility authority and is restored with its original hidden, aria-hidden and tabindex attributes below 721 pixels.
Repeated DOM rerenders and width transitions create no duplicate controls or listeners.
The visible control uses tablist/tab semantics, correct aria-selected state, roving tabindex, visible focus and a minimum 44 pixel target.
The existing server `status=active|archived` parameter remains authoritative; the adapter contains no fetch, storage or parallel client-side lifecycle model.
Search and ordinary filters survive switching; a selected plan absent from the returned set cannot remain as stale detail.
Empty active, archive and secondary-filter results use distinct operator text.
No mobile-specific feature is added; the existing select remains the unchanged mobile/narrow fallback.
State changes remain complete with no motion and under `prefers-reduced-motion`.
Focused tests, desktop Playwright, full project CI and GRACE final pass on one exact head before squash merge, post-merge CI and terminal archive.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: The exact branch head proves one-action desktop lifecycle navigation and exact narrow-width fallback through the existing status query without data-contract or mobile-mode changes.
